name: rare-heist
description: Rare Heist: a turn-based stealth heist in a 1-bit cutaway building, starring your own Rare Friend. Shared Last Heist rounds; simulated rewards only.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js server/*.mjs; do node --check $f || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node --test tests/levels.test.cjs tests/burn.test.cjs tests/solver.test.cjs tests/solutions.test.cjs && node tests/server-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:ui: node tests/campaign-browser.mjs && node tests/wallet-browser.mjs && node tests/travel-browser.mjs && node tests/editor-browser.mjs
